branch_rule.positive_surface_head: For h_surface>0 the saturated surface-to-zero contribution diverges as q->KSAT+, so search for a strictly interior q>KSAT root.
branch_rule.zero_surface_head: For h_surface=0 first evaluate the finite q->KSAT+ unsaturated path-length limit. If limit < 5 cm, admit q=KSAT with zero-head saturated plateau length 5-limit. If limit = 5 cm within endpoint tolerance, admit q=KSAT without plateau. If limit > 5 cm, search for an interior q>KSAT root.

oracle_a.endpoint_limit: Evaluate q=KSAT unsaturated path with h=h_top*t^8 and explicit t=0 limiting value.
oracle_a.interior_root: Use y=log10(q/KSAT-1), deterministic sign scan and high-precision bisection. Path integral uses the same t^8 variable transform and mpmath adaptive quadrature.

oracle_b.endpoint_limit: Evaluate q=KSAT with an independently powered h=h_top*t^12 transform and fixed 256-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature in t.
oracle_b.interior_root: Use y=log10(q/KSAT-1), deterministic sign scan and fixed-GL path evaluations followed by bisection.

acceptance: Both oracles resolve every frozen witness without nonfinite values.
For h_surface=0, both endpoint path-length limits agree within 1e-9 cm and produce the same ENDPOINT_KSAT or INTERIOR_ROOT classification.
For every interior-root witness, oracle fluxes agree within 1e-9 KSAT and each path residual meets its frozen tolerance.
For every endpoint witness, q is exactly KSAT by branch definition and the independently computed plateau lengths agree within 1e-9 cm.
No acceptance threshold is changed after execution.
hard_nonclaims: This gate does not qualify a Ross candidate face.
This gate does not qualify the inherited steady_q oracle outside the frozen witnesses.
The prior 5 cm boundary-face failure remains binding.
No finite-positive ponding-head, runoff, production, runtime or MultiSWAP admission follows.
The endpoint branch is a reference-oracle classification, not permission to alter constitutive physics.
